correctness.rationale: Hoeffding indicator expansion gives A=sum_{ij}(C_15(t_i,t_j)-t_i t_j) and B=sum_{ij}(min(t_i,t_j)-t_i t_j)>0 for 19 exact rational thresholds. The actual check_frank.py was inspected: it brackets exponentials and logarithms using rational truncated Taylor series with proven positive tail bounds and compares exact integer endpoints for all 361 CDF terms; certified A/B>0.93092569 and latent rho<0.92938730. An independent 65-digit evaluation reproduced ordinal 0.930925698735820068..., latent 0.929365805485040128..., gap ~0.00155989325, but is NOT substituted for the rational certificate. The general theta->infinity assertion is separately established analytically by the covariance-deficit kernel, exponential domination and theta-rescaling; g(u)=(1-cos pi u)/2 has derivative-energy/variance quotient pi² vs 12 for g(u)=u, yielding pi²(12-pi²)/6. Uniform finite quantization approximates g at each fixed sufficiently large theta. No claim of finite m uniform in theta.

originality.rationale: Barbiero (2026) proposes attenuation of Pearson correlation for Frank-ordinal scores compared with latent Spearman correlation and reports numerical work limited to <=11 categories and latent rho<=0.9; its Theorem 2 proves sign-preservation, not magnitude attenuation. The exact twenty-category example is beyond the reported search and contradicts the universal attenuation conjecture, while the asymptotic mechanism establishes a family of witnesses. Searches did not reveal a covering counterexample; exact priority remains bounded.
